# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in this guide.

This repository is a **personal, read-only publication**: issues and pull requests are disabled, and outside contributions are not accepted. The content reflects a deployment that was validated end to end, and it is maintained by its author only.

## What you can do

- **Use it.** Clone or fork the repository and adapt the procedure to your environment, under the terms of the [licenses](../README.md#license): MIT for code and configuration files, CC BY 4.0 for documentation and diagrams.
- **Report a security problem in the guide** — for example, a command or configuration that weakens the security of a server built with it — privately, as described in the [security policy](SECURITY.md).
- **Report problems with Ascender itself** to its maintainers:
  - Ascender: <https://github.com/ctrliq/ascender/issues>
  - Ascender installer: <https://github.com/ctrliq/ascender-install/issues>
  - Community forum: <https://forum.ascender-automation.org>

## Conduct

Every interaction related to this project is covered by the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
